name: External Payment Transaction Status 1 Code
definition: Specifies the status of an individual payment instructions, as published in an external payment transaction status code set.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

ACCC.name: Accepted Settlement Completed Creditor Account
ACCC.definition: Settlement on the creditor's account has been completed.

ACCP.name: Accepted Customer Profile
ACCP.definition: Preceding check of technical validation was successful. Customer profile check was also successful.

ACFC.name: Accepted Funds Checked
ACFC.definition: Preceding check of technical validation and customer profile was successful and an automatic funds check was positive.

ACIS.name: Acceptedand Cheque Issued
ACIS.definition: Payment instruction to issue a cheque has been accepted, and the cheque has been issued but not yet been deposited or cleared.

ACSC.name: Accepted Settlement Completed Debitor Account
ACSC.definition: Settlement completed.|Usage : this can be used by a Market Infrastructure reporting to Infrastructure Participant or an Account Servicer to Account Owner to report that the transaction account entry has been completed.|Warning : this status is provided for transaction status reasons, not for financial information. It can only be used after bilateral agreement

ACSP.name: Accepted Settlement In Process
ACSP.definition: All preceding checks such as technical validation and customer profile were successful and therefore the payment instruction has been accepted for execution.

ACTC.name: Accepted Technical Validation
ACTC.definition: Authentication and syntactical and semantical validation are successful

ACWC.name: Accepted With Change
ACWC.definition: Instruction is accepted but a change will be made, such as date or remittance not sent.

ACWP.name: Accepted Without Posting
ACWP.definition: Payment instruction included in the credit transfer is accepted without being posted to the creditor customer’s account.

BLCK.name: Blocked
BLCK.definition: Payment transaction previously reported with status 'ACWP' is blocked, for example, funds will neither be posted to the Creditor's account, nor be returned to the Debtor.

CANC.name: Cancelled
CANC.definition: Payment initiation has been successfully cancelled after having received a request for cancellation.|Usage: code to be used in the context of APIs only.

CPUC.name: Cash Picked Up By Creditor
CPUC.definition: Cash has been picked up by the Creditor.

PATC.name: Partially Accepted Technical Correct
PATC.definition: Payment initiation needs multiple authentications, where some but not yet all have been performed. Syntactical and semantical validations are successful.

PDNG.name: Pending
PDNG.definition: Payment instruction is pending. Further checks and status update will be performed.

PRES.name: Presented
PRES.definition: Request for Payment has been presented to the Debtor.

ACPD.name: Accepted Clearing Processed
ACPD.definition: Status of transaction released from the Debtor Agent and accepted by the clearing.

RCVC.name: Received Verification Completed
RCVC.definition: Verification of Payee check has been applied to received transaction stating to be complete without mismatching data.

RVNA.name: Received Verification Completed Not Applicable
RVNA.definition: Verification of Payee check has been applied to received transaction stating to be complete with not applicable data.

RVNM.name: Received Verification Completed No Match
RVNM.definition: Verification of Payee check has been applied to received transaction stating to be complete with mismatching data.

RVMC.name: Received Verification Completed Match Closely
RVMC.definition: Verification of Payee check has been applied to received transaction stating to be complete with data matching closely.

ACFW.name: Accepted Funds Checked Waiting Confirmation
ACFW.definition: Preceding check of technical validation and customer profile was successful, and an automatic funds check was positive, but an explicit confirmation by the initiating party is outstanding.

RVNC.name: Received Verification Not Completed
RVNC.definition: Verification of party check on the transaction is not yet completed.

RVCM.name: Received Verification Completed With Mismatches
RVCM.definition: Verification of Payee checks have been applied to received transaction stating to be completed containing mismatching data.
